_note: List prices in USD per million tokens, used by upward_stats.py to fill the
`cost` column. Only `input` and `output` are required per model: cache reads
default to 0.1x input, 5-minute cache writes to 1.25x input, and 1-hour cache
writes to 2x input. Override any of those by adding cache_read /
cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h to a model entry.
A model id is matched exactly first, then by longest key that is a substring
of it, so dated ids (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) hit their undated key. A model
with no entry is priced as unknown and its rows show `?` instead of a number.
These are defaults, not a live feed - verify against the current price list.
Long-context (>200k input) premium tiers are NOT modelled: the transcript does
not record which context tier a call was billed at.
To change prices without editing the plugin, drop a file of the same shape at
.upward/pricing.json in your project; its `models` entries win per model id.
